name: Graphify
description: Agent-plane capability: grounded codebase/docs knowledge graph via an MCP server. Gives agents durable memory and 'how things connect' queries.
author: Nova

settings.label: Graphify MCP server URL
settings.description: Base URL of a Graphify MCP server speaking Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC (e.g. http://localhost:8787/mcp). Falls back to the GRAPHIFY_MCP_URL env var.

settings.label: Graphify API key
settings.description: Optional bearer token for the MCP server. Prefer the GRAPHIFY_API_KEY env var over storing a secret in settings.

settings.label: Request timeout (ms)
settings.description: How long to wait for an MCP tools/call before aborting.

tools.name: graph.query
tools.description: Ask a natural-language question against the knowledge graph and get a grounded answer with source references.

question.description: Natural-language question, e.g. "which modules depend on the plugin SDK?".

limit.description: Maximum number of results/references to return.

tools.name: graph.related
tools.description: Find entities connected to a given entity in the graph (callers, dependents, related docs).

entity.description: Entity name or identifier, e.g. a symbol, file path, or module id.

depth.description: How many hops to traverse from the entity (default 1).

tools.name: graph.ingest
tools.description: Index a repository or document set into the knowledge graph. Write operation — separately permissioned from reads.

source.description: Repository URL or absolute path to ingest.
